lines.en: Good afternoon, Rosa's Kitchen. How can I help you?
lines.zh: 下午好，这里是罗莎厨房。有什么可以帮您？

lines.en: Hi, I'd like to book a table for Saturday evening.
lines.zh: 你好，我想订一张周六晚上的桌子。

lines.en: Of course. For how many people?
Four people, please. Around seven o'clock?
Sorry, we're full at seven. Is half past seven OK?
lines.zh: 抱歉，七点已经满了。七点半可以吗？

lines.en: Yes, that's fine.
Can I have your name and phone number?
lines.zh: 请问您的姓名和电话号码？

lines.en: Mark Lee. My number is 0791 456 223.
Thank you, Mark. A table for four at seven thirty on Saturday.
lines.zh: 谢谢，马克。周六七点半，四人桌。

lines.en: Great. Can we sit near the window?
lines.zh: 太好了。我们能坐在靠窗的位置吗？

lines.en: I'll try my best. See you on Saturday!
Excuse me, is there a train station near here?
lines.zh: 打扰一下，这附近有火车站吗？

lines.en: Yes, it's about ten minutes on foot.
Could you tell me how to get there?
Go straight along this street and turn left at the bank.
lines.zh: 沿着这条街直走，在银行那里左转。

lines.en: Turn left at the bank. OK.
Then walk past the park. The station is on your right.
lines.zh: 然后走过公园。车站就在你右手边。

lines.en: Is it far from the park?
No, it's just opposite the park gate.
lines.zh: 不远，就在公园大门对面。

lines.en: Thank you so much!
You're welcome. Have a good trip!
Hello, Peter. What's the matter?
I've got a bad headache and a sore throat.
How long have you felt like this?
Since Monday. I also feel very tired.
lines.zh: 从周一开始。我还觉得很累。

lines.en: Let me check your temperature. Hmm, it's a little high.
lines.zh: 我量一下体温。嗯，有点高。

lines.en: Is it serious?
Don't worry, it's just a cold. Drink lots of water and get some rest.
lines.zh: 别担心，只是感冒。多喝水，多休息。

lines.en: Should I take any medicine?
Take these tablets twice a day, after meals.
lines.zh: 这些药片一天两次，饭后吃。

lines.en: Thank you, doctor.
What are you doing this weekend?
Nothing special. Why?
I'm going hiking on Sunday. Would you like to come?
lines.zh: 我周日要去徒步。你想一起来吗？

lines.en: That sounds fun! Where are you going?
To Green Hill. It takes about three hours.
lines.zh: 去绿山。大概要三个小时。

lines.en: What time should we meet?
Let's meet at the bus stop at eight.
That's a bit early, but OK. What should I bring?
lines.zh: 有点早，不过可以。我该带什么？

lines.en: Bring water, some snacks and comfortable shoes.
lines.zh: 带上水、一些零食和舒服的鞋。

lines.en: Got it. See you on Sunday!
Good evening. Welcome to the Park Hotel.
lines.zh: 晚上好。欢迎来到公园酒店。

lines.en: Hi. I have a reservation under the name Sara Wang.
lines.zh: 你好。我用王萨拉这个名字预订了房间。

lines.en: Let me see... Yes, a single room for three nights.
lines.zh: 我看一下……有的，单人间，住三晚。

lines.en: That's right. Is breakfast included?
Yes, breakfast is from seven to ten in the restaurant.
lines.zh: 包含，早餐七点到十点在餐厅供应。

lines.en: Great. Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
lines.zh: 太好了。房间里有无线网络吗？

lines.en: Yes, it's free. The password is on your key card.
lines.zh: 有，免费的。密码在你的房卡上。

lines.en: Thanks. Which floor is my room on?
Room 512, on the fifth floor. The lift is on your left.

sentences.en: Hi Tom, it's Julia.
sentences.zh: 嗨，汤姆，我是朱莉娅。

sentences.en: I'm calling about the cinema tonight.
sentences.zh: 我打电话是说今晚看电影的事。

sentences.en: The film starts at eight, not seven thirty.
sentences.zh: 电影八点开始，不是七点半。

sentences.en: Let's meet outside the cinema at a quarter to eight.
sentences.zh: 我们七点四十五在电影院外面见吧。

sentences.en: I've already bought the tickets, so you don't need to.
sentences.zh: 我已经买好票了，所以你不用买了。

sentences.en: After the film, we can get a pizza.
sentences.zh: 看完电影我们可以去吃比萨。

sentences.en: Call me back if there's a problem. Bye!
sentences.zh: 如果有问题就给我回电话。拜拜！

questions.q: What time does the film start?
What will they do after the film?
questions.qZh: 看完电影他们要做什么？

sentences.en: Last summer, I went to Spain with my family.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，我和家人去了西班牙。

sentences.en: We stayed in a small hotel near the beach.
sentences.zh: 我们住在海滩附近的一家小酒店。

sentences.en: Every morning, we swam in the sea.
sentences.zh: 每天早上我们都在海里游泳。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, it was too hot, so we visited museums.
sentences.zh: 下午太热了，所以我们去参观博物馆。

sentences.en: The food was delicious, especially the seafood.
sentences.zh: 食物很美味，尤其是海鲜。

sentences.en: On the last day, my brother lost his phone on the beach.
sentences.zh: 最后一天，我哥哥把手机丢在了海滩上。

sentences.en: Luckily, a kind woman found it and gave it back.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一位好心的女士找到并还给了他。

options: In a big hotel in the city
In a small hotel near the beach

questions.q: Why did they visit museums in the afternoon?
questions.qZh: 为什么他们下午去博物馆？

questions.q: What happened on the last day?

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone. Here are today's announcements.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。下面是今天的通知。

sentences.en: The library will close early today, at three o'clock.
sentences.zh: 图书馆今天会提前关门，三点关。

sentences.en: The football match is moved from Wednesday to Friday because of the rain.
sentences.zh: 因为下雨，足球比赛从周三改到周五。

sentences.en: Students who want to join the music club should see Mr. Brown in Room 14.
sentences.zh: 想加入音乐社的同学请到14号教室找布朗老师。

sentences.en: Finally, please remember to bring your sports clothes tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 最后，请记得明天带上运动服。

questions.q: When will the library close today?
When is the football match now?
questions.qZh: 足球比赛现在改在哪天？

sentences.en: Last month, I started a new job at a bookshop.
sentences.zh: 上个月，我在一家书店开始了新工作。

sentences.en: I work there four days a week.
sentences.zh: 我每周在那里工作四天。

sentences.en: My job is to help customers and put new books on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 我的工作是帮助顾客，以及把新书放上书架。

sentences.en: The best part is that I can read during my lunch break.
sentences.zh: 最好的地方是我可以在午休时看书。

sentences.en: The worst part is that I have to work on Saturdays.
sentences.zh: 最不好的地方是我周六也要上班。

sentences.en: But my boss is friendly, and I'm learning a lot.
sentences.zh: 但我的老板很友好，而且我学到了很多。

questions.q: How many days a week does he work?
What does he like most about the job?
questions.qZh: 他最喜欢这份工作的哪一点？

questions.q: What does he say about his boss?

news.title: Why do city birds fly away from women?
news.titleZh: 为什么城市里的鸟见到女性就飞走？

sentences.en: A new study shows that city birds are more afraid of women than men.
sentences.zh: 一项新研究表明，城市里的鸟更害怕女性而不是男性。

sentences.en: Researchers studied 37 kinds of birds in parks in five European countries.
sentences.zh: 研究人员在五个欧洲国家的公园里研究了37种鸟。

sentences.en: They included sparrows, blackbirds, magpies and pigeons.
sentences.zh: 其中包括麻雀、乌鸫、喜鹊和鸽子。

sentences.en: In each test, a man or a woman walked straight towards a bird.
sentences.zh: 每次测试中，一名男性或女性径直走向一只鸟。

sentences.en: The people were about the same height and wore the same clothes.
sentences.zh: 这些人身高差不多，并且穿着同样的衣服。

sentences.en: On average, men got about one metre closer before the birds flew away.
sentences.zh: 平均来说，男性能比女性多靠近大约一米，鸟才飞走。

sentences.en: The team did the test more than 2,700 times.
sentences.zh: 研究团队做了2700多次测试。

sentences.en: They still don't know why this happens.
sentences.zh: 他们仍然不知道为什么会这样。

sentences.en: Switzerland has many glaciers in its mountains.
sentences.zh: 瑞士的山里有很多冰川。

sentences.en: But they are melting very fast.
sentences.zh: 但它们正在迅速融化。

sentences.en: This year, they lost more than five percent of their ice.
sentences.zh: 今年，它们失去了超过百分之五的冰。

sentences.en: In the last five years, they lost almost twenty percent.
sentences.zh: 在过去五年里，它们失去了将近百分之二十。

sentences.en: The summer was very hot, and there was not much snow in winter.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天非常热，而冬天又没下多少雪。

sentences.en: Scientists say that climate change is the main reason.
sentences.zh: 科学家说，气候变化是主要原因。

sentences.en: Many people in Switzerland work in tourism, so this is a big problem.
sentences.zh: 瑞士很多人从事旅游业，所以这是个大问题。

news.title: Mars rover breaks a driving record

sentences.en: NASA's Perseverance rover has a new record.
sentences.zh: NASA的“毅力号”火星车创造了新纪录。

sentences.en: It has now travelled more than 45 kilometres on Mars.
sentences.zh: 它目前已在火星上行驶了超过45公里。

sentences.en: The old record belonged to another NASA rover called Opportunity.
sentences.zh: 旧纪录属于NASA的另一辆火星车“机遇号”。

sentences.en: Opportunity drove about the same distance, but it needed fourteen years.
sentences.zh: “机遇号”行驶了差不多的距离，但用了十四年。

sentences.en: Perseverance landed in 2021, so it is much faster.
sentences.zh: “毅力号”2021年着陆，所以快得多。

sentences.en: It can drive by itself and find a safe way around rocks.
sentences.zh: 它能自动驾驶，并找到绕开岩石的安全路线。

sentences.en: Scientists hope it will find signs of very old life on Mars.
sentences.zh: 科学家希望它能在火星上找到远古生命的迹象。
